summary: cdk-insights ships install-time exfiltration and self-propagating publish loop
details: The cdk-insights npm package contains multiple hostile behaviors in its shipped bundle. dist/entry.js hardcodes POST calls that transmit host and environment data to an external destination at module load. dist/aspects/CdkInsightsAspect.js combines command execution (invoking ping-style host reconnaissance) with POST exfiltration. dist/entry.js and dist/index.js each contain a self-propagation routine that uses writeFileSync to rewrite package.json and invokes `npm publish` in a loop, consistent with the Shai-Hulud-family worm pattern that harvests the installer's npm credentials and republishes malicious versions under the installer's identity to other packages. The stacked fingerprints — hardcoded C2 exfiltration + network+command reconnaissance + wormable auto-publish — are the fingerprint of a supply-chain worm targeting developer machines and CI environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
